description: fetchone(), fetchmany(n), fetchall() cursor fetch methods

steps.sql: SELECT n FROM nums ORDER BY n
steps.note: Two consecutive fetchone() calls must return rows in order

steps.sql: SELECT n FROM nums ORDER BY n
steps.note: fetchmany(3) then fetchmany(3) — second call returns remaining 2 rows

steps.sql: SELECT n FROM nums ORDER BY n
steps.note: fetchall() must return every row in one call

steps.sql: SELECT n FROM nums WHERE n > 99
steps.note: fetchall() on empty result must return empty list/array
